41. Hexagonal and Clean
Architecture

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Hexagonal architecture separates core application logic from external adapters through
ports. Clean Architecture similarly emphasizes dependencies pointing inward toward policy.
සිංහJලෙන් Domain සහ application core එකට database, UI Jහහෝ framework details Jකළින්ම ඇතුළතේ
Jනාකර ports සහ adapters වලින් සම්බන්ධ කරනවා.
A REST adapter calls an order use case; a persistence adapter implements its repository port.
REST adapter Order use case · core Repository port SQL adapter · Read the diagram: External adapters connect to the core through defined ports. · Core එකට adapters සම්බන්ධ Jවන්Jන් ports හරහා.
Expected result: The use case knows the port, not the framework or SQL adapter.

Q: What direction should source dependencies point?
A: Toward stable core policies/abstractions; adapters depend on ports rather than the core
importing adapter details.
